description: Compare two lists and see what is only in one, only in the other, and in both. A HelpySelf tool (helpyself.com).

ignoreBlank.description: Drop empty lines rather than counting them as entries. On by default; off, a blank line on both sides shows up under both.

ignoreCase.description: Treat Alice and alice as the same entry. On by default. The output keeps whichever spelling appeared first rather than lower-casing it.

listA.description: The first list, one entry per line. Order does not matter: each side is treated as a set, and the answer is what is only in A, only in B, and in both.

listB.description: The second list, one entry per line, compared against listA the same way.

trim.description: Ignore space at either end of a line when comparing, so 'Alice ' and 'Alice' match. On by default.

name: compare_two_lists
title: Compare Two Lists
